title: React v2 Intake: connect existing chat UI and wizard to real backend — AI Intake calls wizard API, Manual Wizard calls existing assessment tile flow, both create real missions
goal: The existing ui-v2/src/components/Intake.tsx has a working chat UI and Mission Profile sidebar but sends simulated AI responses. Wire it to the real backend. REQUIRES backlog-268. (1) AI INTAKE MODE — The handleSend function currently returns hardcoded responses. Replace with: call POST /api/v1/engagements/{id}/intake-interpretation (or the relevant wizard interpretation endpoint) with the user text. If no engagement yet: first call POST /api/v1/engagements to create one, store id in Zustand. On response from the intake interpretation endpoint, display the AI's actual response text. Extract from the response: assessment_type, targets, depth, safety fields and update the MissionSummary state. When all four fields are confirmed, the 'Confirm & Launch Mission' button becomes active. On confirm: POST /api/v1/engagements/{engagementId}/scope with allowlist_json built from targets, POST /api/v1/inventory/runs with engagement_id and assessment_type, then POST /api/v1/engagements/{engagementId}/runs with profile_name derived from depth choice and source_inventory_snapshot_id. On success: navigate to /mission-control and store selectedRunId in Zustand. (2) MANUAL WIZARD MODE — Replace the placeholder 'Traditional Wizard mode' with the actual tile-based wizard flow matching the production wizard logic: Step 1: Show assessment tile grid. Import ASSESSMENT_TILES constant (same 13 tiles as current wizard: External Web, Internal LAN, Active Directory, etc.) each with icon (use Lucide equivalent), description, phase tags. Clicking a tile highlights it, updates summary. 'Target & Depth →' button advances to Step 2. Step 2: Target input (text field, auto-detects URL/CIDR/domain, shows interpretation text below input). Depth cards: Passive / Active Scan / Full Pentest — each shows phases involved. 'Preview Mission →' button advances. Step 3: Mission preview card showing: assessment type pill, target, depth, phase breakdown, estimated time. Authorization checkbox 'I confirm written authorization from the system owner'. 'Create Mission & Open Mission Control' button disabled until checkbox checked. On confirm: same API calls as AI mode. (3) BOTH MODES share the right-column Mission Profile sidebar (already implemented). (4) MODE PERSISTENCE: store selected mode ('ai'|'wizard') in localStorage so returning to /intake shows last used mode.
scope: Intake.tsx already has the UI shell. This task wires it to the real API and implements the manual wizard tile flow.
generation_reason: Intake must create real missions via the AegisPT API. The conversational and wizard modes both need real backend integration.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Intake screen only. Do not build other screens.
constraints.roe_gate: Authorization checkbox is mandatory before mission creation. Never skip.

success_criteria: AI Intake mode calls real backend for interpretation responses.
Engagement is created on first message if none exists.
Mission Profile sidebar reflects real extracted data.
Confirm button creates real engagement + inventory + run via API.
On success, navigates to /mission-control with run selected.
Manual Wizard shows all 13 assessment tiles with correct data.
Tile grid → Target input → Preview → Authorization checkbox → Create Mission flow works end to end.
Authorization checkbox required before mission creation.
Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors.
